description: Where the two OpenSync pods (pod_1, pod_2; EMOSA adapter) stand in each native layout. Mid-edge between extenders in the homes and large rooms, between the gateway and the far extenders in the lanes and courtyards; in the band-steering lane in the corners behind the gateway, off the band-steered clients' paths (build-goldens.py checks that no pod comes within 3 dB of the best native 2.4 GHz AP of a band-steered client).
